decision: octabam's scale catalogue (modules/scales, MIT) re-vendored for the shared scale (#1145): scales.s and octabam's LICENSE copied unchanged into vendor/octabam-scales/, so sdk:imports:check pins the file the 52 masks come from. sdk/machines/octatrack/modwerk_scale.s carries the sc_masks words as its own table, by ID from 1, and sdk/tests/test_shared_scale.py checks them word for word against this copy and runs this copy's sc_snap against the shared snap. Nothing else from scales.s is built: its chooser, keys, KEY field and scales.work stay octabam's.
